method: Original 0x68ee40 including inverse-matrix0x5b5b90 and homogeneous transforms0x5c03e0. Synthetic platform, retained-contact record and negative candidate header yield an empty copied candidate list; this allows checking the carry proposal and no-hit refusal without replacement callbacks. No live contact is claimed.

contracts.translationOnly: proposalXYZ=queryXYZ+(currentTranslation-priorTranslation), with Y translation divided by vertical stretch.
contracts.transformed: Convert internal query Y to foot/world Y: (queryY-radius)*stretch. Subtract prior translation, multiply inverse prior3x3, then current full matrix. Return proposed internalY=worldY/stretch+radius.
contracts.acceptance: These no-hit fixtures preserve the original query position, retain iteration count and restore the scratch arena. Actual support-hit acceptance still needs collision fixtures.

limits: Only Y-axis platform rotations with nonuniform scale were sampled; arbitrary 3D rotations and singular matrices are untested.
Negative candidate header is a bounded fixture to bypass contact geometry; the recovered transform does not itself prove live moving-platform collision or carry acceptance.
